provenance.layer: 1 - recorded-dose parsing against real vendor objects
provenance.parser: ctdose_core.rdsr (DICOM PS3.16 TID 10011-10013 coded content items)
provenance.sample_source: OpenREM test objects (GPL-3.0), openrem/remapp/tests/test_files/CT-*.dcm. The objects themselves are third-party and are not redistributed here; this table holds only measurements read out of them.
notes: Sigma(event DLP) is compared against the SR's own accumulated DLP; a difference is reported, never corrected.
The irradiation-event count declared by the SR is read by an independent tree walk (declared_event_count) rather than by the parser.

files.note: not a CT Radiation Dose SR (e.g. a secondary-capture dose screen)
